title: Cops Uncover Horrific Child Abuse In Florida Home
description:
Bodycam footage shows the intense interrogation of Jacob Kubai after doctors discovered shocking injuries on his four-month-old daughter, Willow “Strawberry” Kubai. Polk County, Florida detectives confront the young father with autopsy results, surveillance footage, and his own shifting statements as he claims to hear voices and denies reality itself. What follows is a chilling breakdown of accountability, denial, and a crime that ultimately led to a 30-year prison sentence. Watch the investigation unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
